name: Diao Chan
title: The Dancer with Unrivaled Beauty

skills.name: Seed of Animosity
skills.text: During your action phase, you can discard a card and select two other male characters. It is then viewed as one of the players used a DUEL 决斗 on the other player. This DUEL cannot be responded to with NEGATE 无懈可击. Limited to once per phase.

skills.name: Envious Moon
skills.text: At your end phase, you can draw a card.

differenceFromNormal: The description of "Seed of Animosity" has been modified such that you cannot use it on yourself even if you have a male character card as your major character card. Note that the gender of the victims is based on the main character if both are exposed, or based on the only exposed character. But otherwise, this character is unchanged from SGS.
